name: פטפט: סיפור אינטראקטיבי // Pat-Pet: An Interactive Tale
author: CatEngineDVD
description: PatPet - an interactive tale that describes an immigrants experience coming to Israel. The viewer is an integral part of the work: your input guides the story through seven chapters, each populated by characters drawn in a variety of techniques, from traditional to high-tech. Interact using mouse movements and clicks - experiment in each chapter!
